title: Tone, Bias, and Audience
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting tone, bias, and audience to a tone, bias, and audience edit table, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Classify loaded language into the four bias patterns (unobservable cause, person label, false urgency, audience mismatch) and select the matching repair move
Apply the observability, behavior, and audience checks to flag and replace audience-wrong words, naming the reader before scanning
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
